intent_contract.text: 겨울 저녁 작은 기차역 플랫폼의 지붕과 빗물 자국을 찍은 사진. 사람은 없음.

The request calls for a photograph of a small railway platform roof and its rainwater traces on a winter evening, with people explicitly excluded. The roof is understood contextually as the platform shelter canopy, and the traces as visible runoff staining rather than a request for active rainfall. My restrained authorial direction contrasts the shelter's straight structure with irregular accumulated water marks; a little platform and rail context keeps the object readable as part of a modest station. I prefer this to an isolated close study of stains because the surrounding platform makes their place and purpose legible. Warm practical light against cold dusk and faint wet paving are optional authorial circumstances, not requester definitions. The intended experience is quiet attention to weather recorded on ordinary infrastructure. The camera direction and height are unprescribed. Saved creativity 1 informs these close, restrained choices; effective sensual and fetish treatments are zero because no people is explicit, and surreal treatment is zero.

An architectural photograph of the roof canopy of a small railway station platform on a winter evening. The roof and its rainwater stains are the main subject: dark, uneven runoff streaks descend along the fascia and spread beneath the roof seams, with pale dried tide lines edging the dampened patches. The canopy occupies most of the frame, while a narrow strip of platform paving, one supporting post, and the parallel rails establish its modest station setting. A single warm platform lamp draws out the overlapping stain edges and the slight roughness of the roof surface against the cold blue-gray dusk. The platform is empty, its paving carrying a subdued wet glimmer. Preserve the quiet difference between a working shelter's straight structure and the irregular water traces that have accumulated on it. Natural tonal transitions and legible surface texture make the photograph feel observed and still, with the surrounding station kept subordinate to the stained roof.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Both effective intensities are zero; no added emphasis is active.

authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The request calls for a photograph of a small railway platform roof and its rainwater traces on a winter evening, with people explicitly excluded. The roof is understood contextually as the platform shelter canopy, and the traces as visible runoff staining rather than a request for active rainfall. My restrained authorial direction contrasts the shelter's straight structure with irregular accumulated water marks; a little platform and rail context keeps the object readable as part of a modest station. I prefer this to an isolated close study of stains because the surrounding platform makes their place and purpose legible. Warm practical light against cold dusk and faint wet paving are optional authorial circumstances, not requester definitions. The intended experience is quiet attention to weather recorded on ordinary infrastructure. The camera direction and height are unprescribed. Saved creativity 1 informs these close, restrained choices; effective sensual and fetish treatments are zero because no people is explicit, and surreal treatment is zero.
authorial_core.subject: The roof canopy of a small railway station platform, with visible rainwater stains.
authorial_core.setting: A small railway station platform on a winter evening.
authorial_core.event: Rainwater stains remain visible on the platform roof while the platform is empty.
visual_priorities: The canopy and its rainwater stains carry the principal subject and surface detail.
Irregular runoff streaks and tide lines contrast with the roof's straight edges and seams.
A subordinate strip of platform and parallel rails makes the shelter's railway setting legible.
Warm platform light reveals the stains against cold winter dusk while the platform remains empty.
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: An architectural photograph of the roof canopy of a small railway station platform on a winter evening. The roof and its rainwater stains are the main subject: dark, uneven runoff streaks descend along the fascia and spread beneath the roof seams, with pale dried tide lines edging the dampened patches. The canopy occupies most of the frame, while a narrow strip of platform paving, one supporting post, and the parallel rails establish its modest station setting. A single warm platform lamp draws out the overlapping stain edges and the slight roughness of the roof surface against the cold blue-gray dusk. The platform is empty, its paving carrying a subdued wet glimmer. Preserve the quiet difference between a working shelter's straight structure and the irregular water traces that have accumulated on it. Natural tonal transitions and legible surface texture make the photograph feel observed and still, with the surrounding station kept subordinate to the stained roof.
